title: With Cache Components in a PRODUCTION build, a synchronous fs read freezes into the static shell
statement: With cacheComponents enabled, under `next build` followed by `next start`, a Server Component reading an artifact with fs.readFileSync produces output baked into the static shell, so a later external write does not change what a fresh request returns.
notes: Carved out of AST-0007 after the dev refutation. This is what the documentation actually describes, and it is untested. ⚠️ It may never matter: #2 and #22 make the app local-only, so `next dev` may be the only mode this product ever runs in — which is itself a decision nobody has taken. ⚠️ REGISTERED VALIDATION TASK, DEFERRED 2026-08-22 under #80 branch 3 — not an outstanding debt. DEC-0001 makes this blocking only when a production build enters scope, and the product is local and runs `next dev`. Validating it now would test an UNDECLARED deployment mode: demand-driven sequencing means the experiment arrives with the commitment that needs it. REOPENING CONDITION: execute before adopting `next build` / `next start`, or when upgrading beyond the currently tested Next.js version (16.3.1 / React 19.2.8 / Node v24.18.0). ⚠️ The condition fires when the risk becomes POSSIBLE, not when it is observed — #80's stated preference, because the second means shipping the failure once to learn it was real.
